build_train_val_test_split: build a stratified train/val/test split from an attributes JSON file with configurable ratios
compute_dataset_attribute_stats: compute frequency statistics for each attribute category and label across a dataset
train_feature_maker_resnet: train a ResNet-18 feature extractor model on attributed image data with optional visualization
extract_features_and_build_kdtree: extract features from a dataset using a loaded model and save a KDTree with image names
load_feature_extractor_model: load a pretrained feature extractor model from a saved checkpoint with configurable gradient settings
